prompted_for: Design parameters on a general arrangement drawing (Spec as callouts on the page's equipment drawing)
composition: navy page with logo bar and breadcrumb
light condensed caps headline and subline top-left
large isometric skid drawing filling the centre
layout_devices: detail inset box with zoom lines
line_and_texture: fine detail on pumps, membranes, heat exchanger
motion_implied: drawing traces in line by line
callouts extend and labels type in
t2i_keywords: isometric line drawing of industrial process skid
white hairline linework on deep navy
t2i_prompt: Precise white hairline isometric drawing of <CONTENT> equipment centred on a deep navy page, no shading, 1 px strokes, with fine detail on pumps, housings, pipework and a control cabinet. Around the edges, uppercase parameter labels with values connect to exact components by thin leader lines with dot ends. A square detail inset at top-right magnifies one joint with zoom lines. Dimension lines along the base. Light uppercase condensed headline top-left with one figure in steel-blue. Calm blueprint spec-sheet look.
signature_idea: Every design parameter is pinned by a leader line to the part of the skid it describes.
strengths: palette and line weight close to brand
weaknesses: stainless pipework contradicts a polypropylene maker
brand_fit_why: Navy, white hairlines, a single steel-blue figure and light caps headline fit; label density and all-caps reduce calm.
